rv.q: De Haddad’s direction seamlessly creates a wonderful story and perhaps makes the audience a little nostalgic for the old black and white television show they remember.
BrightSide Theatre’s delightful professional production is the audience and critically approved version of the show.
BrightSide Theatre’s The Addams Family Musical is recommended, offering a spirited, nostalgic, and thoroughly enjoyable night out for audiences of all ages.
It’s a good choice to kick off the spookiest month with this show.

cn.t: BrightSide Theatre delivers a charming and theatrically entertaining production of The Addams Family Musical, capturing the beloved characters' wonderfully odd world with immediate appeal and dark elegance.
